(1) **Yes**, a keyboard shortcuts overlay (modal dialog) is open.
*   **Title:** "Keyboard shortcuts"
*   **Content/Entries:**
    *   **Chat:**
        *   New chat: `Ctrl N`, `Ctrl Shift O`
        *   Archive chat: `Ctrl Shift A`
        *   New standalone chat: `Ctrl Alt O`
        *   Open side chat: `Ctrl Alt S`
        *   Toggle pin: `Ctrl Alt P`
        *   Mark chat unread: `Ctrl Shift U`
    *   **Navigation:**
        *   Clear all unread indicators: `Shift Escape`
        *   Find: `Ctrl F`
        *   Focus browser address bar: `Ctrl L`
        *   Back: `Ctrl I`
        *   Browser back: `Alt Left`
        *   Browser forward: `Alt Right`

(2) N/A (The overlay is open).

(3) **Yes**, there is a toast notification at the bottom. The exact text is: **"No C..."** (the rest of the text is obscured by the overlay, but it starts with "No C"). The toast also has a "Dismiss" button on the right side.
